raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Fixes the legacy trainer deprecation text in two places:

- `verl/trainer/main_ppo.py` logs "deprecated, and wil be removed in v0.9.0.Please set ...": a misspelling of "will", and a missing space between the two sentences.
- `RayPPOTrainer`'s `@deprecated` message has the same misspelling.

Both also promise removal in v0.9.0. `verl/version/version` on main is `0.10.0.dev` and the legacy trainer is still shipped, so the message now says "a future release" instead of a version that has already passed.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Queries: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=%22wil+be+removed%22 and https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=legacy+trainer+deprecated (no results)
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`

### Test

Text-only change. `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` pass on `verl/trainer`; both files compile.

### API and Usage Example

None.

### Design & Code Changes

Two string edits, no behavior change.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the Contribute Guide.
- [x] Applied the repository's ruff checks to the changed files.
- [ ] Add / Update the documentation: not applicable, no documentation mentions the old text.
- [ ] Add unit or end-to-end test(s): not feasible, the change is a log and deprecation string.
- [ ] CI request: I cannot reach the Slack workspace; a maintainer approval for the workflows is needed.

files.patch:
@@ -190,7 +190,7 @@ def main(config):
         from verl.trainer.main_ppo_v0 import TaskRunner
 
         logger.warning(
-            "Legacy trainer `main_ppo_v0.py` is deprecated, and wil be removed in v0.9.0."
+            "Legacy trainer `main_ppo_v0.py` is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. "
             "Please set `trainer.use_v1=True` in config to use V1 trainer."
         )
         run_ppo(config, task_runner_class=TaskRunner)

@@ -282,7 +282,9 @@ def compute_advantage(
     return data
 
 
-@deprecated("Legacy trainer is deprecated, and wil be removed in v0.9.0. Please use `trainer.use_v1=True` instead.")
+@deprecated(
+    "Legacy trainer is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Please use `trainer.use_v1=True` instead."
